signature.name: VTask.UniformConvergenceCLM
signature.type: {𝕜₁ : Type u_1} -> {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} -> [NormedField 𝕜₁] -> [NormedField 𝕜₂] -> (σ : 𝕜₁ →+* 𝕜₂) -> {E : Type u_3} -> (F : Type u_4) -> [AddCommGroup E] -> [Module 𝕜₁ E] -> [TopologicalSpace E] -> [AddCommGroup F] -> [Module 𝕜₂ F] -> [TopologicalSpace F] -> Set (Set E) → Type (max u_3 u_4)

conventions.statement: VTask.UniformConvergenceCLM σ F 𝔖 is definitionally equal to E →SL[σ] F as a type; the synonym exists solely to carry a different topology instance.
conventions.note: The type synonym mechanism allows the uniform-convergence topology and any other topology on continuous linear maps to coexist without instance conflict.

conventions.statement: When 𝔖 is the empty family of subsets, the topology of uniform convergence on 𝔖 is the indiscrete topology.
conventions.note: The definition is still well-formed; no sets to converge on means no nontrivial open sets from the uniform-convergence construction.

conventions.statement: The synonym forms a topological vector space only when the continuous linear image of every set in 𝔖 is bounded in F; this is a hypothesis, not enforced by the definition.
conventions.note: Without this condition the topology is still defined but may lack the required algebraic-topological compatibility.

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜₁ 𝕜₂ : Type*} [NormedField 𝕜₁] [NormedField 𝕜₂] (σ : 𝕜₁ →+* 𝕜₂) {E : Type*} (F : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜₁ E] [TopologicalSpace E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜₂ F] [TopologicalSpace F] (𝔖 : Set (Set E)), ∃ _ : VTask.UniformConvergenceCLM σ F 𝔖 ≃ (E →SL[σ] F), True
